messages:
Ari: quick find from a docs sweep: several pages still show the legacy function_call field and a couple of example links 404. i'd like to do a small, safe rollout: PR1 = redirects + link fixes, PR2 = snippet rewrite + tiny migration note + compact-envelope canonical example.

Bea: +1. can you paste the grep or issue?

Ari: opened issue with grep: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1212. hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/examples/, /docs/reference/structured-output/. two external posts reference old slugs too.

Noah: i'll take redirects. i'll move obsolete examples into /docs/legacy-examples/ and add redirect stubs. small PR so CI stays quick.

Bea: i'll do the snippets. plan: show before/after for py and ts; illustrate tools=[...] as the new pattern; add a short note on providing a JSON schema for tool args and a one-line compatibility shim for older SDKs. also add guardrails: prefer explicit property types, avoid top-level union arrays, mark critical fields required.

Ari: sounds good. keep the migration note <=3 lines and point to the compact-envelope example which will be the canonical parseable pattern.

Noah: PR A for redirects opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5333. Linkcheck flagged 6 broken links; this PR fixes them by adding redirects and moving originals to legacy.

BuildBot: automated: linkcheck report attached for PR 5333. https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/reports/5333 (6 failures fixed in PR).

Bea: PR B draft ready: includes small py/ts before-after snippets, compact-envelope example at /docs/reference/structured-output/compact-envelope.md, and a 3-line migration blurb in /docs/migration.md. added a one-liner shim: "# shim for older SDKs: resp = client.compat_wrap('get_user')" labeled temporary.

Noah: PR A merged. redirects live. nice and quick.

Bea: opened PR B: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5339. requesting review from @Ari and @Noah. preview built: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/5339

Ari: reviewed, left a tiny wording nit on the shim wording (call it "temporary compatibility shim" and encourage upgrade). also asked to add a one-sentence parser-fallback ordering note (schema -> compact-envelope -> heuristics).

Bea: addressed nits, updated migration note to recommend upgrade and added parser-fallback ordering line. merged PR B after preview passed. :tada: If you find other legacy snippets ping me and i'll follow up.
